column1: # THE SERVICE CATALOG — which service is in which profile, and what container
# it becomes.
#   <compose service> <TAB> <container name> <TAB> <profiles> <TAB> <icon> <TAB> <port>
# profiles: comma-separated, MUST mirror the `profiles:` list in
#           docker-compose.yaml. `up` starts services by explicit NAME, not by
#           passing `--profile` to compose, so a service missing here is simply
#           never started for that profile regardless of what compose says.
#           That is how telegraf, influxdb and acmesh silently never ran —
#           taking the whole syslog pipeline and cert issuance with them.
# port:     primary host port, or `-` for internal-only.
# icon:     display only.
# CONTAINER NAMES DO NOT TRACK SERVICE NAMES (2026-08-03). Compose SERVICE names
# are unchanged because they are what containers resolve each other by —
# kong.yaml upstreams `web:5000`, VA_DATABASE_URL is `db:5432`, pgcat and
# telegraf likewise — so renaming them breaks docker DNS on every deployed node.
# Container names are `va-` prefixed and ROLE-named: web -> va-app,
# freeswitch -> va-voip, the SBC kamailio -> va-sbc (was va-ingress), the egress -> va-egress. Anything
# doing `docker exec` must resolve through this catalog, never guess.
# WHY THIS IS DATA. `scripts/check-services.sh` cross-checks it against
# docker-compose.yaml, and that compose file stays in THIS repo while the CLI
# moves to va-crystal (docs/next-cli-boundary.md). A guard that cannot travel
# with the code has to stop being part of it.
postgres
pgcat
redis
# app only. The node's NATS check is FATAL (startup_checks.cr exits 1 after its
# retries, unlike the FreeSWITCH and InfluxDB probes), so a voip-only node must
# point VA_NATS_URL at a reachable broker — the `nats:$VA_NATS_HOST` extra_host
# on the voip service is what makes that resolvable.
nats
minio
web
admin
kong
kamailio-ingress
gatus
mailpit
# Missing from this catalog until 2026-07-29, so `up` (which starts by NAME)
# never started them: no telegraf meant every service's syslog went nowhere, and
# no acmesh meant TLS could never be issued.
influxdb
telegraf
acmesh
ofelia
# The SIP plane, one container (was kamailio-egress/va-egress, freeswitch/va-voip
# and node/va-node — see the `voip` service in docker-compose.yaml). Port 5060
# because that is what an operator looks for on a voip node; the node's 4000 and
# FreeSWITCH's 8021 live in the same container and are reachable there too.
voip
